description: Нагрузочное тестирование: метрики k6 рядом с RED, runtime Go и пулом pgx сервисов за тот же интервал.
title: Delivery / Load

panels.description: k6_http_reqs / интервал против k6_target_rps (gauge из сценария). Расхождение вместе с dropped_iterations — генератор или система не успевает.
panels.title: RPS: целевой и достигнутый

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'достигнутый (http_reqs)' AS series, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_http_reqs'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'целевой (target_rps)' AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_target_rps'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p50/p95/p99 клиентской задержки POST /orders по гистограмме k6 (бакеты k6 грубые: 5/10/25/50/75/100/250/500/750/1000 мс, значение интерполируется внутри бакета). Точные числа ступеней — в summary.json прогона.
panels.title: Latency k6 (http_req_duration)

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'p50' AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_duration' AND ServiceName = 'k6'
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.5 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, (b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.5 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i]) * 1 AS value
FROM q
ORDER BY time

WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'p95' AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_duration' AND ServiceName = 'k6'
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, (b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i]) * 1 AS value
FROM q
ORDER BY time

WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'p99' AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_duration' AND ServiceName = 'k6'
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.99 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, (b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.99 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i]) * 1 AS value
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Доля неуспешных запросов (http_req_failed) и доля проваленных проверок (checks) по k6.total: condition=zero — значение 0 (успех для http_req_failed, провал для checks).
panels.title: Ошибки k6

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'http_req_failed' AS series,
  sumIf(Value, Attributes['condition'] = 'nonzero') / sum(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_failed.total'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat('check: ', Attributes['check']) AS series,
  sumIf(Value, Attributes['condition'] = 'zero') / sum(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_checks.total'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: k6_dropped_iterations появляется только при пропусках (нет данных = пропусков не было). VU против vus_max: упёрлись в maxVUs — генератор не успевает.
panels.title: dropped_iterations и VU

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'dropped_iterations' AS series, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_dropped_iterations'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'vus' AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_vus'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 'vus_max' AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_vus_max'
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Итоги k6 за выбранный диапазон по тегу stage. Тег появится вместе с профилем stress; в smoke одна строка «—». Перцентили — по бакетам гистограммы k6 (грубо); точные числа — в summary.json.
panels.title: k6 по ступеням (stage)

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT if(Attributes['stage'] = '', '—', Attributes['stage']) AS stage, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_duration'
  GROUP BY stage
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum,
         arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.5 * n, cum) AS i50, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i95, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.99 * n, cum) AS i99
  FROM h WHERE n > 0
), f AS (
  SELECT stage, n,
    b[i50 - 1] + (if(i50 > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i50]) - b[i50 - 1]) * (0.5 * n - cum[i50 - 1]) / c[i50] AS p50,
    b[i95 - 1] + (if(i95 > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i95]) - b[i95 - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i95 - 1]) / c[i95] AS p95,
    b[i99 - 1] + (if(i99 > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i99]) - b[i99 - 1]) * (0.99 * n - cum[i99 - 1]) / c[i99] AS p99
  FROM q
), e AS (
  SELECT if(Attributes['stage'] = '', '—', Attributes['stage']) AS stage, sumIf(Value, Attributes['condition'] = 'nonzero') / sum(Value) AS error_rate
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_http_req_failed.total'
  GROUP BY stage
), d AS (
  SELECT if(Attributes['stage'] = '', '—', Attributes['stage']) AS stage, sum(Value) AS dropped
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'k6' AND MetricName = 'k6_dropped_iterations'
  GROUP BY stage
)
SELECT f.stage AS stage, f.n AS requests, e.error_rate AS error_rate, f.p50 AS p50, f.p95 AS p95, f.p99 AS p99, d.dropped AS dropped
FROM f LEFT JOIN e ON f.stage = e.stage LEFT JOIN d ON f.stage = d.stage
ORDER BY stage

panels.title: RED сервисов (server): gateway — HTTP, order/user/product — gRPC

panels.description: Серверные запросы в секунду: gateway — http.server.request.duration, остальные — rpc.server.call.duration.
panels.title: RPS сервисов

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product') AND MetricName IN ('http.server.request.duration', 'rpc.server.call.duration')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: gateway: HTTP 5xx; order/user/product: gRPC-статусы UNKNOWN, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, UNIMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL, UNAVAILABLE, DATA_LOSS. Клиентские 4xx/NotFound не считаются ошибкой.
panels.title: Error rate сервисов

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series,
  sumIf(Count, if(MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration', toUInt16OrZero(Attributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500,
                  Attributes['rpc.response.status_code'] IN ('UNKNOWN', 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', 'UNIMPLEMENTED', 'INTERNAL', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'DATA_LOSS'))) / sum(Count) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product') AND MetricName IN ('http.server.request.duration', 'rpc.server.call.duration')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p95 серверной задержки по delta-гистограммам (интерполяция внутри бакета, точность до бакета).
panels.title: p95 сервисов

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product') AND MetricName IN ('http.server.request.duration', 'rpc.server.call.duration')
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, (b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i]) * 1000 AS value
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p99 серверной задержки — по нему видно, какой сервис первым уходит в хвост.
panels.title: p99 сервисов

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product') AND MetricName IN ('http.server.request.duration', 'rpc.server.call.duration')
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.99 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, (b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.99 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i]) * 1000 AS value
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Память, используемая рантаймом Go (stack + other), по сервисам.
panels.title: go.memory.used (сумма по типам)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, ServiceName AS series, sum(used) AS value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName, Attributes['go.memory.type'] AS t, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS used
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'go.memory.used' AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
  GROUP BY time, ServiceName, t
) GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Число горутин по сервисам: рост под постоянной нагрузкой — признак накопления.
panels.title: go.goroutine.count

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'go.goroutine.count' AND ServiceName IN ('gateway', 'order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: pgxpool.acquired_connections / pgxpool.max_connections. 1.0 — пул исчерпан: запросы ждут соединение.
panels.title: Утилизация пула (acquired / max)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series,
  argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquired_connections') / nullIf(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'pgxpool.max_connections'), 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, TimeUnix, Value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquired_connections'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, TimeUnix, Value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'pgxpool.max_connections'
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN ('order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Захваты, когда в пуле не было свободного соединения (pgxpool.empty_acquire). Устойчивая ненулевая скорость — пул мал или запросы медленные.
panels.title: empty_acquire /s

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'pgxpool.empty_acquire' AND ServiceName IN ('order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Суммарное ожидание свободного соединения в секунду (pgxpool.empty_acquire_wait_time, ns → с/с). 1.0 ≈ в среднем одна горутина всегда ждёт.
panels.title: empty_acquire_wait_time (с ожидания в секунду)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series, sum(Value) / 1e9 / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'pgxpool.empty_acquire_wait_time' AND ServiceName IN ('order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Захваты, отменённые по контексту (таймаут/отмена запроса) до получения соединения — прямой признак насыщения пула.
panels.title: canceled_acquires /s

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'pgxpool.canceled_acquires' AND ServiceName IN ('order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Среднее время захвата соединения: pgxpool.acquire_duration / pgxpool.acquires.
panels.title: acquire_duration (среднее)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquire_duration') / 1e9 / sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires') AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('pgxpool.acquire_duration', 'pgxpool.acquires') AND ServiceName IN ('order', 'user', 'product', 'notification')
GROUP BY time, series
HAVING sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires') > 0
ORDER BY time
